semantics: Declared-Delta Registry (ADR 0021 decision 9) — the Translation Ledger repurposed: dispositions classify host-native deltas ABOVE the Contract Floor rather than translation loss. Every divergence carries exactly one classification (mapped | approximated | degraded | unsupported) plus a rationale; an undeclared divergence is a conformance failure (decision 6). Consumed by src/core/semantic-core.ts validateDeclaredDeltas and the per-host Conformance Suites.
